basic.title: Basic information
basic.description: Site name, URL, languages, and time display are used in navigation, auth pages, browser titles, and post timestamps.
basic.datetimeDescription: Timestamps stay stored in UTC; these settings only control how times are shown in the UI.
basic.timezoneHint: Choose the site timezone. Communities in China often use Asia/Shanghai.
basic.startOfWeekHint: Used by calendars and week-based stats. Monday is recommended for many locales.
basic.accountSecurityDescription: Password policy affects new registrations and password resets; the recommended default favors longer passphrases.
basic.passwordRecommended: Recommended default: 12-128 characters, no forced composition.
basic.sessionsMaxDevicesHint: Maximum number of devices that may stay signed in at once (1-20). When exceeded, the oldest device is signed out automatically. Recommended: 5.
basic.sessionsKeepDaysHint: How many days to keep revoked login records for users to review (1-365). A background job cleans up older ones. Recommended: 30.
basic.loginMaxFailuresHint: Lock the account after this many consecutive wrong passwords. 0 disables lockout. Recommended: 10.
basic.loginLockoutMinutesHint: How long login stays blocked after the threshold is hit. 0 means unlock immediately. Recommended: 15.
basic.registrationEnabledOff: Off: only staff can create accounts
basic.registrationEnabledHint: When off, the login page hides registration. The first install registration remains allowed while no users exist. Recommended: on.

registration.title: Registration and usernames
registration.description: Control who may register and username length, charset, and reserved names. Invite/approval flows will be completed in a later iteration.
registration.recommended: Recommended: open registration, usernames 3–20 characters, Unicode letters and numbers.
registration.modeHint: Open: visitors can register. Invite/approval: public registration is closed for now (full invite codes and approval queues come later). Closed: only staff can create accounts.

modes.invite: Invite only (public entry closed for now)
modes.approval: Approval required (public entry closed for now)

registration.requireEmailVerificationHint: When on, registration UX can prompt for email verification (full verification mail flow is completed with mail features).
registration.blockPostingUntilVerifiedHint: Applies only when email verification is required. Recommended on to reduce spam floods after signup.
registration.usernameDescription: Applied when members register or staff create accounts.
registration.usernameReservedHint: Comma-separated, case-insensitive. Matching names cannot be registered.

newcomers.title: Newcomer limits
newcomers.description: Stricter cooldowns, daily caps, and outbound-link rules during a trust window after signup.
newcomers.recommended: Recommended: 7-day window, 5-minute topic cooldown, 1-minute comment cooldown, 3 topics / 30 comments per day, block outbound links.
newcomers.daysHint: Counted from registration. 0 disables newcomer limits. Recommended: 7.
newcomers.zeroUnlimited: 0 means no extra newcomer limit (global forum limits still apply).
newcomers.forbidOutboundLinksHint: Reject topics/comments with http(s) links during the trust window. Recommended on.
newcomers.forbidAttachmentsHint: Disallow uploads during the trust window. Off by default; enable for higher-risk communities.

maintenance.title: Maintenance mode
maintenance.description: When enabled, write operations from ordinary visitors are blocked; staff can still sign in and manage the site.
maintenance.warning: Turning maintenance on immediately affects write traffic site-wide. Confirm before saving.
maintenance.enabledOn: On: the site is under maintenance
maintenance.enabledOff: Off: the site is operating normally
maintenance.enabledHint: Non-admin write requests return 503 while enabled. Recommended: off.
maintenance.messageHint: Shown to visitors, up to 500 characters. Leave blank to use the system default message.
maintenance.messagePlaceholder: Example: Upgrading the site. Back in about 30 minutes.

verification.title: Human verification
verification.description: Configure the verification service used by registration and other risk-sensitive actions.
verification.keepSecretPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current secret
verification.challengeTTLHint: Unit: minutes. Recommended: 20 minutes; 10 is stricter, while 30-60 fits slower forms.
verification.costHint: ALTCHA cost is the client-side PBKDF2 work factor. Higher values make user devices compute longer; start with 1000, then test 3000 or 5000 for higher-risk sites.
verification.secretHint: Use a 32-byte random secret. A new secret replaces the current one only after saving; leaving this empty keeps the existing secret.
verification.secretGenerated: New ALTCHA secret generated. Save to apply it.
verification.secretGenerateUnavailable: This browser cannot generate secure random values.

scenarios.title: Enabled scenarios
scenarios.description: When the service is ALTCHA, these scenarios can require verification; API checks remain authoritative.

passwordReset.description: Require verification before account recovery or reset email requests once that flow is wired.

loginRisk.label: Login risk
loginRisk.description: Require verification for suspicious IPs, repeated failures, or new-device login risk.

postRisk.label: Posting risk
postRisk.description: Require verification when publishing, replying, or high-frequency actions trigger risk controls.

widget.title: Client widget behavior
widget.description: These settings are delivered directly to the ALTCHA widget and control what users see and when verification starts.
widget.typeHint: Checkbox is recommended. Switch is lighter; native follows browser controls more closely.
widget.autoHint: Keeping this off is recommended so users trigger verification intentionally; riskier forms can use focus or submit.
widget.displayHint: Standard is the safest default; floating or overlay can fit tighter forms.
widget.hideLogoHint: Keeps the registration form cleaner without changing server verification.
widget.hideFooterHint: Hides the widget attribution footer while keeping the core verification flow.
widget.workersHint: Recommended: 2. Higher values can finish faster but use more low-end device resources; range 1-16.
widget.minDurationHint: Unit: milliseconds. Recommended: 500 for steady feedback; 0 adds no extra wait.
